title: The Falling Ball
setting: a room at night: a table in the middle with a yellow ball on it, in the back layer.
shots: An orange stick figure walks in slowly from the left, worried, and stops a little left of the table.
The yellow ball rolls off the table and bounces twice on the floor.
The figure gets a fright and runs away to the left.
The figure walks back slowly, looks down at the ball, picks it up and puts it back on the table.
camera: show the table and the figure; follow the figure when it runs away and comes back.
